description: Create and save a Cabinet-X cloud design without an open browser or desktop app. For “draw a cabinet” or “我要画一个柜子”, call with mode:"singleCabinet" and a fresh requestId; no measurements or customer information are needed. Put everything the user already said into cabinet (type, width in inches, doors), e.g. “30 inch double-door base cabinet” → cabinet:{type:"base",width:30,doors:2}, so the cabinet is right in one call. When the user names the type and width, create it directly without asking. When they only say “draw a cabinet” with no type or width, ask ONE short question first (type: base/drawer/sink/upper/tall, and width — common 24, 30, 36 inches) and accept “any/default” as an answer to use the defaults; never run a multi-question interview. For an empty design canvas use mode:"blank". Both manual modes use the connected project's existing walls or one 120-inch straight wall when none exist, and skip automatic room layout. For a complete kitchen layout use mode:"layout" and provide the measurements in inches or use the connected project's actual walls. Pass projectId and its opaque designId together for an already-connected project; omit both to start a new draft. Return openUrl to the user and keep projectId and the opaque designId in tool calls for follow-up cabinetx_mobile_design edits. Never display the opaque designId in prose.

action.description: Generate by default. To recover a possibly committed result after timeout, call status with only the same requestId. If no result is found, resend identical generation arguments and requestId.

cabinet.description: Only for mode:"singleCabinet". Omitted fields use defaults (ordinary base cabinet, narrowest stock width, automatic door count). The response cabinet field lists the saved cabinet and the widths/swaps it can change to.

doors.description: Door count, e.g. 2 for a double-door cabinet. Not for drawer cabinets.

type.description: base = ordinary door base cabinet; drawer = drawer base; sink = sink base; upper = wall cabinet; tall = pantry.

width.description: Nominal width in inches, e.g. 30. Must be a stock width for that type; an error lists the allowed widths.

customer.description: Customer and project metadata. Required only when starting a new complete layout project.

title.description: Optional project title, e.g. "Main Kitchen L-Shape".

delivery.description: Default owner-only link. Use share only if the user asks for an expiring read-only link. Use handoff only if the user asks to let another person save a copy of a new blank or single-cabinet draft with no customer metadata.

designId.description: Opaque design handle bound to this chat when projectId is supplied.

initialEdits.description: Optional core finish/style edits applied to the new design before saving (e.g. {op:"front",all:true,color:[0.18,0.27,0.38]}).

all.description: For front/pull, apply to the whole design in one core operation.

autoHarmonize.description: Auto-run harmonize after switching vendor (vendorSwitchReconcile, default true).

color.description: front RGB array from actual options, not a color name. Zone/all merges omitted style. Single-object front replaces its pick: preserve untouched fields from the current pick.

count.description: Door or shelf count (doors, shelves, tierDoors).

definitionId.description: Exact replacement catalog definition ID from options (swap, resize).

height.description: Height in inches (height, heightDrag, size, tierHeight).

id.description: Actual object ID from read/options; may be omitted for atomic front/pull scope or all.

includeEndPanels.description: Also add auto end panels where needed (wallAutoFillers, default true).

length.description: Island length in inches (resize with island: ID).

lockedIds.description: Cabinet IDs to keep locked untouched during wallRebalance.

op.description: Core operation name from unified edit schema (e.g. front, pull, resize, retype, remove, finishPick, islandEdit). Never use kind:finish. Query action:"capabilities" with editOp for exact per-op fields.

preferDrawerBase.description: Convert eligible unlocked base cabinets to drawer bases during wallRebalance.

preferMaxSize.description: Maximize island length/width within safe clearance limits (islandSolveFit).

repaint.description: Secondary repaint retaining current door profile (front).

retypeId.description: Exact retype option ID from options (retype).

scope.description: For front/pull: lower, upper, tall, lowerCorners, upperCorners or corners. lower includes lower corner cabinets.

stoneId.description: Existing stone reference from actual design/options, only for single-object front (id, no scope/all). Include other original pick fields when restoring a stone finish.

style.description: front door style code from options. Zone/all can omit for color-only changes; single-object front must include the original style when preserving it.

targetLength.description: Desired island length in inches clamped to safe max (islandSolveFit).

targetWidth.description: Desired island width in inches clamped to safe max (islandSolveFit).

vendor.description: Target vendor code/alias (vendorSwitchReconcile), e.g. AEON, REALWOOD, CLASSIC, OPPEIN.

wallId.description: Wall ID such as A or WALL-A (wallAutoFillers, wallRebalance).

width.description: Width in inches (resize, size, freeWidth, trim, appliance).

mode.description: singleCabinet draws one cabinet (see cabinet). blank opens a canvas with no cabinets. layout runs automatic kitchen design. With mode omitted, a wall survey requests layout, otherwise the default is blank.

projectId.description: Only for a project already connected in this chat.

requestId.description: Fresh UUID for idempotent creation/generation. Reuse the same requestId only when retrying an uncertain timeout with identical arguments.

survey.description: Supply known wall measurements in inches when needed (shape and non-empty walls are required together; empty walls may only pair with shape). I uses wall A; L uses A,B; U uses A,B,C; O uses A,B,C,D. Omit if unknown or when using an existing survey.

ceiling.description: Ceiling height in inches (e.g. 96 for 8 ft, 108 for 9 ft). Defaults to 96.

center.description: Fridge center distance in inches (omit or 0 for corner start).

note.description: Optional notes or sketch remarks saved as AI design notes.

center.description: Sink/water center distance from wall start (L) or end (R) in inches.

wants.description: Optional layout features requested by the user.

from.description: Distance from wall start (L) or end (R) to window edge in inches.

name: cabinetx_cloud_generate
title: Draw a cabinet or create a Cabinet-X design
